definitions.explanation: Moving or happening at high speed. Written as {速|はや}い. Opposite of {遅|おそ}い (slow).
Happening before the expected or usual time. Written as {早|はや}い. Opposite of {遅|おそ}い (late).

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}は{速|はや}いです。
{朝|あさ}{早|はや}く{起|お}きました。
examples.english: I woke up early in the morning.

examples.japanese: もう{帰|かえ}るの？{早|はや}いね！

notes: Two different kanji share this reading: {速|はや}い (speed) and {早|はや}い (time). Both are i-adjectives. Adverb form: {速|はや}く/{早|はや}く. The opposite for both meanings is {遅|おそ}い.
